notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content: [list][*][p]Certain key items will now emit a subtle glow by default, making them easier to spot without needing to be directly observed first.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue where the mouse cursor could drift while navigating menus. While I was unable to reproduce this during extensive playtesting, this update includes a [b]potential fix[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p] Thank you for all the support![/p]

notes.title: HEADING TOWARDS A RELEASE DATE!!!
notes.content:
Here’s what’s next on our agenda:
    
1.    ✅ Let my other tester play through and confirm bugs are fixed.
    
2.    💪 Push myself to the limit to implement Steam achievements.

3.    🕹️ Test the game with a controller.

4.    🎬 Work on a fresh, eye-catching trailer that really shows off what I’ve built.

5.    📅 Announce the official release date and price.

6.    📢 Promote, Promote, Promote! 🚀

Let’s keep the momentum going!🙌
